'''Gate 134''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] gate in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You're cleared for departure at Gate 134.|A security droid, to Raan Calrissian in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
Gate 134 appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books.<ref name="Tethan" />
